name: Hunter's Talent
clause: When this Class enters, target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control.

needs.proposedSignature: `{ op: 'bite', source?: TargetSpec | Ref, target: TargetSpec }` — when `source` is given, that object deals the damage instead of `src`
needs.semantics: 'Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control' is a one-way fight between two objects the ability chooses. game.ts:1471 reads `const a = src.zone === 'battlefield' ? src : this.objs(T)[1]`, so the two-target form only works for a spell; a permanent's triggered ability always bites with the permanent itself. fight (game.ts:1470) is two-way and is not a substitute.
